title: Bring back crappy forums
summary: This editorial piece makes a nostalgic case for reviving old-school web forums as an alternative to modern social media platforms, highlighting how these 'crappy' but authentic community spaces fostered deeper discussions and genuine connections before the era of algorithmic feeds and engagement farming.
problem_solved: Addresses the erosion of authentic online community and meaningful discourse caused by modern social media platforms optimized for engagement over substance.
why_valuable: The article taps into a growing collective frustration with algorithmic social networks and offers web forums' decentralized, topic-focused model as a healthier alternative for online community building.
